The consolidated financial results include results of CARE Ratings Limited and its subsidiaries namely CARE Analytics and Advisory Private Limited (formerly known as CARE Risk Solutions Private Limited), CARE ESG Ratings Limited (formerly known as CARE Advisory Research and Training Limited), CARE Ratings (Africa) Private Limited, CARE Ratings South Africa (Pty) Limited, CARE Ratings Nepal Limited and CareEdge Global IFSC Limited.
